paragraphs.text: # dsh-console-sentinel
> **功能描述**：桌面控制台哨兵：扫描所有控制台窗口，标出哪些已空闲或跑完，一键关闭非白名单窗口，关之前先干跑预览再确认。白名单按进程名或窗口标题子串逐条添加，宿主进程默认受保护。适配 DSH 内

核 0.2.2-rc.1。
>
> **English**: Desktop console watchdog: scans every console window, marks which one
s are idle or finished, and closes the non-whitelisted ones in one click, with a dry-run preview and
a confirm step before anything closes. Whitelist entries are one row each by process image name or
window-title substring, and shell hosts are protected by default. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

A **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin for Windows** that cleans up your taskbar in one click:
close ever

y window of an app the way **Alt+F4** would (graceful `WM_CLOSE`, not a force-kill),
close leftover

**empty console shells**, and never touch the harness itself or an in-progress
Fluent / MPI solver r

mpty console shells**, and never touch the harness itself or an in-progress
Fluent / MPI solver run.
> 中文说明见 README.zh.md
## Why

Windows accumulates windows you no longer need: empty PowerShell/cmd shells left behind by
tooling,

terminals you forgot about, apps you closed the document for but not the program.
Closing them one b

y one is tedious, and a careless "kill everything" script will happily take
down your harness or a r

s, and a careless "kill everything" script will happily take
down your harness or a running CFD job.
This plugin does the closing **safely**:

* it closes **gracefully** (`WM_CLOSE`, exactly what Alt+F4 sends) so apps can save and exit;
* it c

loses **per window, per app, or as a batch** — no clicking through every window;
* it **never** clos

es the DSH host, and never closes Fluent / MPI / ANSYS solver processes;
* it can close **elevated (
admin) windows** too, via a single UAC prompt.
## Features
### One-click taskbar cleanup (preview first)

`预演清理` lists exactly which windows would be closed (with icons), `执行清理` then closes them.
Execute st
ays disabled until you have previewed — no blind destructive clicks.
### Taskbar windows, grouped by app

The **icon grid** view (default) packs every window into a compact 30×30 grid — one click closes
tha

t window. Switch to **detail view** for a per-app card with full titles, a whitelist checkbox,
`关掉该软
件` (close the whole app), and a per-window `关闭` button.
Every close is confirmed first:
### Empty console shell cleanup

A shell with no working child process (just `conhost`) is an "empty shell". Hide them
(lossless, the

process keeps running) or close them for real — only bare
`cmd` / `powershell` / `pwsh` / `python`

ning) or close them for real — only bare
`cmd` / `powershell` / `pwsh` / `python` are ever targeted.
### Persistent whitelist

Programs and window-title keywords that must never be hidden or closed. Stored in
`~/.dsh/console-se
ntinel/whitelist.json`, editable from the panel or the tools.
## Safety model
Bulk-closing windows is a destructive operation, so the plugin layers several hard guards:
| Guard | Behaviour |
| **Host process tree** | The DSH host, all its ancestors, and every descendant (`dsh` / `electron`
/ `deepseek` images) are never touched — closing one of those consoles can take the harness down. |
| **Compute protection** | `mpi` / `fluent` / `ansys` / `cx*` / `solver` / `cae` / `launcher` are ne
ver selected. An `mpiexec` console looks like a plain window but killing it ends a running simulatio

n. |
| **Bare-interpreter only** | Empty-shell closing is restricted to `cmd` / `powershell` / `pwsh

` / `python`. |
| **Foreground & self** | The focused window and the plugin's own process are skippe

d. |
| **Whitelist** | Anything you tick is permanently exempt. |
Graceful close (`WM_CLOSE`) is used everywhere; `taskkill /F` is deliberately **not** offered.
## Elevated (admin) windows

A non-elevated process cannot close an elevated window — Windows UIPI silently drops the message,
wh

ich looks like "the button does nothing". When you close an admin window (Task Manager,
screen recor

ders, …) the plugin starts **one** elevated helper: you get a single UAC prompt, it
sends the same `

WM_CLOSE`, and reports back through a temp file (an elevated child's stdout is
not readable). Answer
**No** and nothing happens — the plugin says so instead of pretending success.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Windows only. Declares `dsh.bundle` (host half) and `dsh.client` (settings-panel half), so it shows
up under **Settings → 控制台哨兵** with a terminal icon.
## Configuration
Defaults in `cordis.patch.yml`:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `scanIntervalSec` | `10` | probe interval |
| `idleThresholdSec` | `60` | how long a console must

idle before it counts as empty |
| `cpuThresholdPct` | `1` | CPU floor for the idle test |
| `autoAc

tion` | `none` | `none` \| `hide` \| `close` for idle consoles |
| `emptyConsoleAction` | `hide` | a

ction for empty shells |
| `guardForeground` | `true` | never touch the focused window |
| `cleanup.

protectedProcesses` | see above | never closed by the desktop cleanup |
| `whitelist.processes` / `.
titles` / `.unprotect` | `[]` | runtime-managed exemptions |
## Tools

Host-side tools for scripted use: `console_windows_list`, `console_windows_action`,
`console_windows

_sweep`, `desktop_windows_cleanup`, plus `sentinel_whitelist` for the
exemption list. A CLI is avail
able via `lib/desktop-cli.mjs list|cleanup`.
